text: 🍿 Robert Pattinson as Chris Hansen is the most unsettling casting of the year 📆 Estreno: September 25, 2025 🎭 Género: #TrueCrime #Drama ✈️ Add to watchlist Lance Oppenheim built his rep on docs that feel fiction-adjacent (Ren Faire, Spermworld), so flipping that lens onto To Catch a Predator is a genuinely smart move. Robert Pattinson doesn't do an impression; he plays the hunger behind the performance, that barely-contained thrill of a man who knows the cameras love him. The ghillie-suit moment in the clip is peak TCAP absurdity. Oppenheim keeps it deadpan. That instinct is exactly why this works.

🍿 Four hours on Musk. And yeah, it earns them. 📆 Estreno: October 16, 2025 🎭 Género: #Documentary #Biography ✈️ Add to watchlist Alex Gibney knows how to turn a complicated monster into a film. He did it with Scientology in 'Going Clear' , and from what this teaser suggests, he's applying the same forensic patience here. Four hours sounds excessive until you remember the subject has his hands in rockets, social media, the U.S. government, and a dozen other fires simultaneously. The poster looks like it crawled out of a 2003 thriller bin, and somehow that's exactly right. There's a genuine question of preaching to the choir, and Gibney knows it. That tension, between rigor and audience, is what makes his best work land.

🍿 The Mummy 4 is filming. Fraser and Weisz are back. 📆 Estreno: October 15, 2027 🎭 Género: #Action #Adventure ✈️ Add to watchlist Brendan Fraser and Rachel Weisz back for a direct sequel to The Mummy Returns , with Radio Silence ( Ready or Not ) directing. Horror directors on a legacy adventure franchise. I buy that. Imhotep back. Beni back. Yes, both of them. After the third film buried this franchise alive, zero apologies is the right approach. 🏜️
